name: @mux-factory/server
description: Local board for the Mux factory: reads the Mux GitHub Project through gh and shows it as a board.

scripts.dev: pnpm run build:web && { pnpm --dir ../web run build --watch --clearScreen false & trap 'kill $!' EXIT; node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning --watch --watch-path=src --watch-path=../web/dist src/server.ts; }
scripts.sample: pnpm run build:web && BOARD_DATA_FILE=test/sample.json T3_SETTINGS=test/t3-settings.sample.json T3_MODEL_MANIFEST=test/model-manifest.sample.json node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning src/server.ts
